messages:
Nora L.: Heads up: we're greenlit for a short case story with ArcNova. Interview set for Thu 4/8 9am PT. Need: two approved quotes, legal clearance, and a 1-paragraph benchmark blurb. Who takes the notes?
Ravi S.: I can take notes and pull the benchmark numbers. Reminder the tests ran on 2026-01-20; I'll export the public summary.
Ava T.: I'll draft the copy and shortlist 3 tweet-length quotes. Will need transcript and permission for logo usage.
Diego (Sales): Once published, route inbound leads to AE team A. I'll send Sales Ops the routing map. Also want a webinar follow-up slot in two weeks.
Priya (Legal): Legal checklist: consent email, QA on any customer numbers (mark as customer-reported unless we validated), and no PII. Send drafts to me; 48h turnaround.
AssetsBot: Created folder: /marketing/case-studies/arcnova/assets. Checklist: consent, transcript, draft-copy, legal-review, asset-clear.
Nora L.: Great. Action items: Ravi export benchmark by Tue, Ava draft copy by Wed noon, Priya review on receipt. Target publish week of 4/13.
Ravi S.: Uploading sheet now: https://drive.redwood/arcnova/summary-2026-01-20
Ava T.: Draft Qs (short): 1) What changed after switching to Redwood? 2) Can you share a quick metric? 3) Any integration hiccups?
Priya (Legal): I'll block Wed afternoon for review. Please flag any screenshots for separate permission.
Nora L.: Thanks team, I'll send calendar invites and a prep doc with interview prompts. :white_check_mark:
